sentence: An adult learning English talks with an AI partner who never stops them to correct a mistake, then gets one thing to work on in their own language, and learns the words of their own books before reading them.

shows: a microphone and the learner's voice going in
a laptop running Ogmios with the conversation on screen
a focus card where the learner's sentence is fixed
a word card from the learner's book with its sentence
a chip with the day the word comes back

picture.claim: You talk with the partner by voice or by typing, and nothing corrects you while the conversation runs.
shows: the real conversation screen
the microphone button held down
the note No corrections now. Just talk

picture.claim: A mistake you repeat climbs from detected to mastered, and it only reaches mastered when you get it right in real conversations.
shows: one repeated mistake as a card
the four steps detected, in focus, improving, mastered
a short drill
a later conversation where it comes out right

sections.heading: Learn the words of your own books

picture.claim: Add a book and see which chapters you can already read; each new word is learned with the book's own sentence and comes back before you forget it.
shows: an EPUB book
a bar per chapter that fills as you learn
a word card with the book's sentence
a calendar of review days

sections.heading: Your data stays on your computer

picture.claim: Your voice, books and progress stay on your computer; only the text of the conversation goes to Claude.
shows: the computer as a place with walls
voice turned into text inside it
the saved books and progress inside it
only text leaving for Claude

icons.why: the app itself draws every icon with lucide-react: 2 px round line, the same look as the interface

objects.why: one-colour objects take palette roles and sit beside lucide line icons
